meta.name: build-a-place
meta.description: Build a place in Blender in parts (a village, town, harbour, mine, farm, garden, interior, a set or props) from the requester's plain words: plan with researched sizes, ground first, parts built side by side, combined, given real surfaces and wear, audited, drawn with the film owner's renderer rule, checked by fresh helpers, fixed once and checked again
meta.whenToUse: When someone asks for a place, set or props to be built in Blender, whatever the words (they need not mention surfaces, wear or realism: this workflow adds the plugin's own steps). Pass the plugin folder, the kit folder, a work folder and the request exactly as the person wrote it; the notes about this computer, the disk and the money come in args.environment.

phases.title: Plan
phases.detail: one planner: style note, facts with sources, draft settings, ownership, acceptance list, parts, views, readable features

phases.title: Ground
phases.detail: the ground part first, alone, then frozen so every other part is seated on it

phases.title: Build parts
phases.detail: one builder per part, side by side up to a cap, each running its own share of the pass and its own checks

phases.title: Combine
phases.detail: one integrator: both orders, ownership check, the whole surface-and-wear pass

phases.title: Audit
phases.detail: the audit and the preflight stage place on the exact file; up to two repair rounds routed to the owners; no picture before it passes

phases.title: Render
phases.detail: the renderer rule (Cycles where lit, EEVEE when not), previews, measures, the style guard

phases.title: Check
phases.detail: fresh checkers (look, structure, process, a blind reader), then a skeptic merges and ranks

phases.title: Fix
phases.detail: exactly one fix round: one fixer per owner, given only the confirmed findings

phases.title: Re-check
phases.detail: a different fresh checker and a second blind reader look at the changed place

phases.title: Report
phases.detail: the final gate on the saved file, then a plain-words report
